prerequisites: Shared lab openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-work2 (work2) built from 067c1646829df85e62b809ee9157921e867c84e7 with lab.mjs; Helix seed, light profile, random seed 7, seeded 2026-09-25T09:59:53.804Z to 2026-09-25T10:00:16.340Z; organization timezone Europe/London. Each identity signs in in its own Playwright Chromium context: Daniel Okafor (Administrator) and Nadia Haddad (Legal Team Member) by password; Jonas Weber (Business User) by a fresh magic link read from the lab Mailpit.

The organization lead times [30,14,7,1,0], the Comment emails switch and the MCP policy (off) were read first and put back at the end. Two fictional Legal Team Members were invited through Settings > Users and set their timezones; the morning round ran in the lab worker by queuing the cron's own pg-boss job (the dev trigger route answers 404 on this lab). One MCP Tool call came from an API key Nadia Haddad requested and Daniel Okafor approved on the lab, with MCP and Legal API keys turned on for that step only.
scenarios.expected: Lead-time changes, the comment-words switch and audit facts are observable at the documented scope; reminders follow the recipient's timezone; Tool calls list the MCP call; changes made through MCP read 'via' the Client.
scenarios.actual: 15 recorded steps passed. Organization > Notifications opened /settings/reminders with headings ["Personal","Organization","Comment emails","Reminder lead times"] and the list ["30 days before","14 days before","7 days before","1 day before","On the day"]; the note reads "These are the default lead times for expiries, notice deadlines, Key dates and obligations. People can set their own in Notifications. Keep at least one lead time.". Personal > Notifications opened /settings/notifications with Notification preferences and the switch "Use the organization's default lead times". Add lead time with 33 and Cancel saved nothing. 9 + Save added "9 days before". A second 9 stayed in the add row with "days before the date 9 days before is already on the list. Save Cancel"; 731 with "days before the date Enter a whole number of days between 0 and 730. Save Cancel". "On the day" (0) is on the list: true. ArrowUp moved "9 days before" from 6 to 5; after reload the list read ["30 days before","14 days before","7 days before","1 day before","9 days before","On the day"]. 14 temporary entries filled the list to 20; 90 was then refused with "days before the date The list holds at most 20 lead times. Remove one first. Save Cancel" and the list stayed at 20. Remove took the temporary entries away again. The Comment emails card's switch started on (true); help "Applies to everyone in the organization. When off, mention, comment and reply emails link to the record without including the comment's words.". Turning it off saved and read off after reload; it was turned back on. Audit log Search "comment" shows 12 of Daniel Okafor's rows, newest "Daniel Okafor changed the organization settings commentWordsInEmail: No → Yes System Administrators this minute". Invited "DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 Reminder ready 0925132548" (timezone Asia/Dubai, local hour 17) and "DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 Reminder early 0925132548" (Pacific/Honolulu, local hour 3) as Legal Team Members; each set a password from the invitation mail and saved the timezone on Profile. Each manages one Matter (M-207, M-208). Key dates on M-207: KD listed A 7 0925132548 on 2026-10-02: This date will remind: 30 days before, 14 days before, 9 days before, 7 days before, 1 day before, On the day; KD listed B 7 0925132548 on 2026-10-02: This date will remind: 30 days before, 14 days before, 9 days before, 7 days before, 1 day before, On the day; KD unlisted 11 0925132548 on 2026-10-06: This date will remind: 30 days before, 14 days before, 9 days before, 7 days before, 1 day before, On the day; KD own lead 15 0925132548 on 2026-10-10: This date will remind: 30 days before, 15 days before, 14 days before, 9 days before, 7 days before, 1 day before, On the day. The Key dates page showed the generic error page 0 times on navigation and loaded after Reload. The round ran through pg-boss job notification.morning-round queued in openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-work2-worker-1 (trigger route answered 404): {"id":"4757c2cd-353f-4488-b05c-b21727ecaf73","state":"completed","output":null}. "DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 Reminder ready 0925132548"'s bell items per Key date: {"DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 KD listed A 7 0925132548":1,"DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 KD listed B 7 0925132548":1,"DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 KD unlisted 11 0925132548":0,"DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 KD own lead 15 0925132548":1}; header bell "Notifications, none unread"; briefing mail "Your daily briefing" with Key date names {"DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 KD listed A 7 0925132548":true,"DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 KD listed B 7 0925132548":true,"DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 KD unlisted 11 0925132548":false,"DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 KD own lead 15 0925132548":true}. "DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 Reminder early 0925132548" (before 08:00): bell holds its Key date false; briefing mail none. Removed entries down to one ("30 days before"): no Remove control; the list kept 1 entry. The original offsets [30,14,7,1,0] were put back with PUT /api/v1/org/reminder-offsets (200); after reload the page reads ["30 days before","14 days before","7 days before","1 day before","On the day"]. Settings > Advanced > Audit log opened /settings/audit-log with tabs ["Activity","Tool calls"] and columns ["Event","Record","Audience","When"]. Action offered 213 choices; Record offered ["Any record","Contract","Matter","Document","Request","User","Entity","System"]. Person Daniel Okafor + Action "Matter type archived" showed 10 rows, all by Daniel Okafor, for example "Daniel Okafor archived the matter type DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Supplier assessment renamed 0925133420 System Administrators this minute". From/To 2026-09-25 kept 10 rows; 2026-09-24 left 0. Clear filters reset to {"person":"Anyone","action":"Any action","record":"Any record","from":"","search":""}. Unfiltered first page 50 rows; Show older made 100. Search "DOC-030 admin-config V-C38" left 50 rows: 48 name this walk's records and 2 are earlier "exported the audit log" entries whose saved filter holds the same words; one with before-and-after values reads "Daniel Okafor reassigned this matter's type Matter type: DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Supplier assessment renamed 0925133420 → DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Replacement type 0925133420 Matter M-212 · DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Reassigned matter 0925133420 01a0d8c6-". With Person Daniel Okafor and Search "DOC-030 admin-config V-C38" the page showed 50 rows. Export CSV downloaded "openlaw-audit-log-2026-09-25.csv" with header "\"id\",\"created_at\",\"action\",\"entity_type\",\"entity_id\",\"visibility\",\"actor_id\",\"actor_name\",\"actor_email\",\"payload\",\"via_kind\",\"via_id\",\"via_client_name\"\r" and 164 data lines naming this walk's records. The file was saved outside the repository and deleted. Nadia Haddad created Confidential M-213 "DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 Confidential audit 0925133420" (API fixture as Nadia). Daniel's GET of it answered 404. Audit log Search for the title showed 0 entries and Export CSV held 0. After Nadia added Daniel Okafor through Matter team > Add team member, the same Search showed 4 rows (for example "Nadia Haddad added Daniel Okafor to the team Matter M-213 · DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 Confidential audit 0925133420 01a0d8c6-991e-74b0-982d-68fc32bd0306 Working team this minute") and the CSV held 4. MCP policy before: enabled false, Legal API keys false, read-only false; turned on for this step and put back afterwards. Nadia Haddad requested "DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 Headless client 0925132851" on Settings > API keys (Matters, read and write); Daniel Okafor approved it from the bell's Your approvals; Nadia's "Your key is ready" dialog showed the key once (not recorded). The SDK Client connected over /mcp with 10 Tools; openlaw_whoami answered; openlaw_matter_create answered isError=false "{\"number\":210}". Tool calls columns ["When","Person","Client","Tool","Outcome","Duration"]. Rows for "DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 Headless client 0925132851": ["Sep 25, 2026, 5:29 PM GMT+4 Nadia Haddad DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 Headless client 0925132851 openlaw_matter_create Success 14 ms","Sep 25, 2026, 5:29 PM GMT+4 Nadia Haddad DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 Headless client 0925132851 openlaw_whoami Success 5 ms"]. From/To = 2026-09-24 hid them. Load more took the table from 50 to 54 rows. Clear filters reset the dates. Activity Search for the Matter the Tool made reads "Nadia Haddad, via DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 Headless client 0925132851, created this matter Matter M-210 · DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 Matter via MCP 0925132851 01a0d8c1-7f5d-7903-b3e7-f7f2be4bcf0f Working team this minu". Tool calls Export CSV downloaded "openlaw-tool-calls-2026-09-25.csv" with header "\"id\",\"created_at\",\"person_id\",\"person_name\",\"client_name\",\"tool\",\"outcome\",\"duration_ms\"\r" and 54 data lines (file deleted). Activity with Person Daniel Okafor and Action "Export performed" now shows "Daniel Okafor exported the audit log System Administrators this minute". Settings > MCP > Tool calls in the last day opened /settings/audit-log/tool-calls?range=last-day; the tab reads "Last 24 hours: Sep 24, 2026, 5:29 PM GMT+4 to Sep 25, 2026, 5:29 PM GMT+4" (From box ""); it lists 2 rows for "DOC-030 admin-config V-C41 Headless client 0925132851". The walk's key: POST /api/v1/api-key-requests/{id}/revoke answered 200. PATCH /api/v1/mcp-settings answered 200; MCP enabled false, Legal API keys false, read-only false, as before.

scenarios.actual: /settings/audit-log -> /settings/profile; GET /api/v1/audit-log answered 403. /settings/audit-log/tool-calls -> /settings/profile; GET /api/v1/audit-log/tool-calls answered 403. Nadia's Settings rail lists ["Profile","Appearance","Notifications","API keys","View Business Portal"].

limitations: The morning round was run on demand in the lab worker (pg-boss job notification.morning-round) instead of waiting for the hourly cron; it is the same handler on the real clock.
The timezone limit was observed (a colleague whose local time is before 08:00 got nothing); the 'Dates approaching, In-app' and briefing-switch channel limits were not toggled.
Pending and Retry on the Tool calls tab could not be produced on demand; every recorded call finished (Success).

The personal lead-time override was seen only as the switch 'Use the organization's default lead times' on Daniel Okafor's Personal > Notifications page; 'Business Users cannot set their own list' was not exercised.
The org lead-time list briefly held one entry during the last-entry check before the original list was put back with PUT /api/v1/org/reminder-offsets.
